definitions.completion_rate: arrived / all planned, including vehicles never inserted
definitions.mean_speed_mps: vehicle-time weighted samples, including stopped and unfinished vehicles
definitions.hard_braking: episode starts at acceleration < threshold - 1e-6; not a sample count
definitions.weave_both_origins_seconds: time with both pink-approach and green-approach traffic on weave
definitions.weave_cross_origin_follow_vehicle_second: weave vehicle with other-approach leader within 20m; proxy, not proof of yielding
definitions.teleport: disabled (-1); zero teleports alone is not evidence of no gridlock
definitions.completed_trip_metrics: depart delay and time loss exclude unfinished trips; also inspect not_inserted and remaining
